s: Dinay zizin birshut harabbim ubo h' seipim: shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim, vehem shel adam echad o shel shenayim veerebu yachad (al derek sheyyitbaer besimman sha"g bigzuzetraot), muttar lizroq mizzeh lezeh derek mala measara, shezzehu mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek meqom petur. Veim haya gag zeh gaboah miggag zeh — asur lizroq miggag zeh legag zeh, ben mehaggaboah lehannamuk uben mehannamuk lehaggaboah, lepi shehazzoreq miggaboah lenamuk o lehepek tzarik leammen yadayv, veshemma lo yukal leammen yadayv veyippol hachepetz lirshut harabbim, veyishkach vibiennu lirshut hayyachid. Ulepikak im hem kelim hannishbarim keshennopelim, kegon kele cheres uzekukit vekayyotze bahem — muttar lezorqam mizzeh lezeh, sheim yippelu veyishshaberu, en lachush shemma yabi shibrehem lirshut hayyachid. Ubemah shennapelu vehunnechu birshut harabbim, en bezeh issur hotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim min hattora, hoil velo nitkavven lizroq lirshut harabbim. Vekol zeh keshershut harabbim oberet benehem. Abal im hayeta karmelit oberet benehem — muttar bekol inyan, shello gazeru gezera zo bekarmelit mishshum shehi gezera ligzera:

Ziz, dehaynu dap habbolet min hakkotel lirshut harabbim, im hu lemala measara vechallon habbayit patuach lo — muttar lehishtammesh alayv min habbayit derek hachallon, mippene shehu kechore reshut hayyachid, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Vehu shehachallon patuach alayv besamuk lo tok [gobah y' tepachim] [shelosha]. Abal im eno samuk lo — eno niddon kechore reshut hayyachid, vekarmelit hu im yesh bo d' al d'. Veim hazziz hu lematta measara min haaretz, kevan shehu baavir reshut harabbim — zaku bo rabbim, veoserim hem al baal habbayit lehishtammesh bo derek challono, ap al pi shehu patuach lo tok shelosha, ben sheyyesh bo d' al d' ben sheen bo. Vehu haddin im hu bolet laavir karmelit tok asara laaretz:

Im hayu b' zizin zeh lematta mizzeh, vehem shel b' anashim, ap al pi sheshshenehem lemala measara, im yesh bazziz haelyon shellipne hachallon rochab d' al d' — asur lehishtammesh alayv bekelim sheshshabetu betok habbayit, mippene shehu reshut bipne atzmo vehazziz shettachtayv reshut acheret, veoserim zeh al zeh leinyan kelim sheshshabetu babbayit bilbad, kedin shette gaggot o shette chatzerot shel shene anashim vekol kayyotze bahen, sheen tashmishan tadir ketashmish habbayit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"b:

Vaapillu im ziz hattachton en bo d' — oser hu al haelyon im yesh bo d'. Abal im en baelyon d', vegam battachton en d' — mishtammesh bishnehem ubekol hakkotel ad asara tepachim hattachtonim. Veim hattachton yesh bo d', vehaelyon en bo d' — en mishtammesh baelyon ella keneged challono bilbad, sheshsham hu kechore challono. Abal bishar hazziz shebbishne tzedade hachallon asur lehishtammesh, mippene zeh hazziz shettachtayv shechalaq reshut leatzmo, shehare yesh bo d' al d':

Kol ziz hayyotze al avir reshut harabbim, shemmuttar lehishtammesh alayv, keshehu mishtammesh en notenim alayv veen notelim mimmennu ella kele zekukit ukele cheres vekayyotze bahen, sheim yippelu lirshut harabbim yishshaberu. Abal shear kelim asurim, shemma yippelu lirshut harabbim vibiem. Abal im hu yotze al avir karmelit — muttar bekol hakkelim, shello gazeru gezera zo bekarmelit. Vaapillu birshut harabbim lo gazeru ella beziz vekayyotze bo, shehu yotze laavir, abal im hu dabar rachab, kegag shehammishtammesh omed sham im hakkeli — muttar lehishtammesh bo bekol hakkelim:
